messages:
maria: Heads-up — need approval to add 24 H100 GPUs in us-west2 for the new latency-sensitive reranker. Rough estimate: ~$95k/mo additional cloud spend if we go reserved + sustained usage. Looking for finance + infra signoff this week.

aj: Can you break down that estimate? reserved vs on-demand vs spot? also what perf delta are we expecting?

lisa: Quick breakdown from perf runs:
- 24x H100 reserved (1yr): ~$68k/mo (amortized)
- burst capacity (spot/premarket) for peak: +$6k/mo (avg)
- networking/egress addl: ~$21k/mo (cross-region replication & S3 read hot shards)
Perf: ~2.5x throughput vs our current mixed A100 pool for this model at target seq len.

kevin: @maria thanks. finance questions:
1) Is this new spend replacing anything or net-new?
2) Can we cap monthly run rate and include backstop (alerting + kill switch)?
3) Any vendor credits or discounts in negotiation?

maria: Net-new capacity — it will relieve backlog but not decommission A100s yet. We can add an autoscaling policy + budget alert in console to kill non-prod burst when spend > $X. No signed credits yet; sales is talking to cloud rep.

sankar: Proposal: stagger activation — provision 12 H100 as dedicated (reserved) initially, keep 12 for burst. We push some batch workloads to reserved during off-peak to improve utilization. Also consider mixed-precision quant profiles to reduce token cost ~15%.

billing-bot: invoice-alert: detected spike in egress to us-east1 on 2026-09-03 03:14 UTC, cost: $8,240. See billing query: billing:egress:us-east1 > monthly_avg*4

lisa: here's quick billing query output I ran:
```
2026-09-03T03:14 UTC | project:redwood-inference-prod | service:egress | region:us-east1 | amount:$8,240
Top contributors: model-cache-sync, shard-rebalancer
Filter: replication=true, job=cache-sync
```
We should fold cache-sync traffic into a private VPC peering path to avoid public egress. That could knock off ~$6k/mo.

kevin: OK. If we can remove that public egress line and keep the monthly delta <= $60k net-new, finance can pre-approve for a 90-day trial. Need a PO and cost-center tag before provisioning.

aj: timeline check — procurement lead time for reserved H100 is ~6-8 weeks on our CSP marketplace. If we want earlier capacity we can mix in 8-12 preemptible H100s from partner pool for first 3-4 weeks.

maria: Action items I’ll take: 1) add budget alert + kill switch config, 2) create PO draft and attach cost-center tag, 3) schedule network peering to stop egress, 4) finalize stagger plan (12 reserved / 12 burst).

lisa: I’ll open infra change ticket for peering and post the runbook. Also will add quantization checklist to deployment PR.

kevin: Conditional sign-off: thumbs up if infra implements egress fix + we show <=$60k net increase in forecast. Approve for 90-day trial after PO submitted.

maria: @kevin noted. tagging the PO in the thread — https://redwood.internal/po/PR-4829 (placeholder). Please react with :thumbsup: to approve so we can proceed.

kevin: :thumbsup: (final approval pending PO and peering confirmation)

aj: Logged the partner burst option in the capacity tracker. Will follow up on spot availability tomorrow.

maria: Thanks everyone. I’ll update status in Monday all-hands and ping legal for contract review for the reserved line.
